comments.content:
[medium] The format string contains a single `{}` placeholder, yet there's a trailing comma following `i` in the argument list — a syntax error. Either the trailing comma needs to go, or `j` was meant to be part of the format call. Given that `j` was already dropped from the format string, removing the trailing comma is the right fix.

```suggestion
            prefix_replace["adapter.body.{}.".format(i)] = "body.{}.".format(i * 2)
```
[low] In `internal_routes.py`, add a boundary test for `get_logs` with the smallest valid input.
